readme_snippet: Data Presentations A presentation is a data story constrained by a room, a clock, and a person talking over it. Those three constraints change almost every design decision — which is why a deck is not a report with page breaks. The rule everything else serves Every content slide's title is a full-sentence assertion, left-justified, no more than two lines. Not a topic. Not a label. "Q3 revenue grew 12% on enterprise renewals" — yes. "Q3 Results" — no. This is the most over-determined rule in the entire field. Six independent traditions arrived at it separately: Alley's assertion-evidence (28 pt, ≤2 lines, left-justified), Duarte, Reynolds ("write a declarative statement rather than a title"), Doumont ("a complete sentence, with a subject and a verb… no more than 12 words or so"), consulting action titles ("NEVER have a title that is longer than two lines"), and NYT-style claim-titling. Nothing else in the canon has that much agreement behind it.

Security model The security model for SQL execution in Supabase Studio is based on the principle of "proven authorship". description: 把一篇论文做成 LaTeX 中文解读 PDF。本地 PDF / arXiv 取原文 → MinerU 全文解析 → 深读 → 填固化 LaTeX 模板(ctexart+fandol，含 keybox / 图块宏 / 我的评价结构)→ xelatex 出 PDF。硬规则:原文关键图必须嵌入，自画示意图只能补充不能替代。当用户要把某篇论文 / PDF 做成"解读 PDF / 论文解读 / LaTeX 解读"，或要一份可打印分享的论文导读 PDF 时用。
readme_snippet: paper-jiedu-latex 一句话:MinerU 把论文变成结构化材料 → 亲自写一份诚实、量化、带原文关键图的中文解读 → 固化 LaTeX 模板出 PDF。 目标是看得懂且信得过——不是翻译摘要，不是把作者自称的贡献当事实。 硬规则(顶格，不可跳) 原文关键图必须有。挑 3--6 张最能支撑结论的原文图(contour / 结构 / 机制云图)嵌进去，放在对应结论旁边，中文 caption 以"原文 Fig.\,N："开头。个人解读属合理使用，标注来源即可，不能因版权顾虑省略。 自画示意图(TikZ)是加分项，不能替代原文图。它给几何/框架导览，替代不了论文的真实数据图。可留作导览，紧跟其后放原文图。 一手纪律:每条关键结论区分"论文声称"vs"我验证过"；没查证的说没查证，不凭训练记忆补。 诚实标边界:模型假设删了什么(如无粘=删边界层)、样本量多小、否定性结论有没有正对照、是否作者自证体系——都写进"我的评价"。 中文写作纪律:量化在前(先给数字再给形容词)；不写 AI 味套话(避免"值得注意的是""总的来说"这类填充语)；中文语境标点用全角；数字与英文之间不留空格。 复杂公式和关键思路要展开逐步讲解。核心公式不能抄进来一句话带过——要拆每个符号的含义、走一遍推导(哪步用了什么、哪一项因为不含参数被扔掉)、并点破"这一步的直觉/为什么这么写"。判据:一个非该子领域的聪明读者能不能顺着读懂。做法:关键推导用 equation 环境显式分步列出，配一句"关键就在这一步"点破洞见，必要时用 keybox 圈出"全文支点"。方法/机制章节(§2 方法内核)是重灾区，别只搬摘要级别的一句话。 步骤 取原文 PDF:本地文件 / arXiv 下载 / 出版社官网。 全文解析:用 MinerU 解析 PDF → 输出目录(内含 paper.md / contentlist.json / images/)。已解析过就别重跑。 深读:读完 paper.md，逐节抓"解决什么问题 / 方法内核 / 主要结果 / 验证 / 局限"，论文声称 vs 我判断分开。 挑图 + 映射:scripts/mapfigures.py 列出 图→8位hash→caption；照 caption 挑 3--6 张；mapfigures.py --copy figs 1c0f74b0...

readme_snippet: Uniform forms A form in Uniform is not a special entity — it is a composition of components. A Form container component renders the element and owns the resulting submit action; each input is its own component placed in the container's slot. Authors assemble forms in Uniform's visual editor; developers own the markup, state, and submission. Architecture Field components self-register with that context on mount and read/write their own value through it. The container never inspects its slot contents. Author-set Field name and identifier Every field must have a stable, author-set identifier. The name parameter is required on every field component. Slugify it to get the identifier used for the HTML name/id, and the payload key. Never fall back to a generated identifier, warn in the Uniform's visual editor when a field is missing an identifier. Form Submit or Fields should self-register Do not introspect slots. Do not walk component.slots.formFields to build fields.
